newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Colgate pulled from list.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Colgate pulled from list.

text.p: - Prudential Securities Inc said Monday it is removing Colgate-Palmolive Co as a Single Best Idea, which also removes it from Prudential's Select List.
- Prudential maintained Colgate's buy rating and earnings estimate of $4.85 for 1997.
- Prudential analysts said Colgate is trading at a relatively high premium. That is warranted by Colgate's strong fundamentals, analysts said, but expansion from those levels "may be more modest."
- Colgate shares were trading at 111-3/4, down 2 from their Friday close.
